invariants.rationale: The bucket index is based on totalBuckets, which is incremented and assigned as an int >= 0.
The method puts fileIdHint mapped to the returned bucket index (result).
A new BucketInfo is put into bucketInfoMap at index result before return.
BucketInfo for that bucket index contains fileIdHint as set in the method.
The BucketInfo created and inserted at this bucket uses the same partitionPath argument.
